title: Proximity Decision Map & Microflow Tiles for Onboarding Quickstart
creator: Lena Novak
description: Design a compact set of onboarding visuals that explain Redwood's region-and-latency routing logic with minimal text. Deliverables: a) three micro-map SVG tile variants that can be composed into a responsive hero, b) a 1-panel explainer diagram showing the routing decision path (proximity -> pinned topology -> capacity -> fallback), c) two annotated product screenshots for the quickstart that overlay routing metadata (latency corridor, chosen region, fallback path), and d) an accessibility-friendly color palette and alt-text drafts. Visuals should be modular so engineering can animate a single 'route highlight' overlay in the console. These assets will be used in the product quickstart, onboarding email, and docs hero for the release.
acceptance_criteria: Three SVG map tile variants (Cluster, Corridor, Micro-proximity) exported at 1x and 2x with clear layer naming and tokenized colors
One flat explainer SVG (1200x600) with numbered microflow steps and copy hooks for localization
Two annotated console screenshot PNGs with overlay mock data (region, measured 95th p50 latency, fallback mapping) and supplied alt-text drafts
Handoff package uploaded to Figma + export-ready zip for frontend (SVGs, PNGs, CSS token mapping)
Design review sign-off from PM and Engineering (comments resolved) and a GitHub issue linking the front-end integration task
